details:
When using the native Apple Silicon builds of Unity 2022.3.6f1, *which provides ample improvements to performance and stability over Intel versions ran through Rosetta 2*, the Harmony Library, used by the `UdonSharpEditorManager`, is currently incompatible with Apple Silicon [[source](https://github.com/pardeike/Harmony/issues/424#issuecomment-1595898404)] due to a difference in memory access, triggering a reoccurring memory access error:

